facts.text: Through the South Dakota Advantage tuition program, residents of 11 neighboring states—Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Wisconsin, and Wyoming—pay the same reduced tuition rate as South Dakota in-state residents.

sources.title: South Dakota Advantage | University of South Dakota
sources.quote: Through SD Advantage, residents of Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Wisconsin and Wyoming are offered the same reduced tuition rate as South Dakota residents.
